en.sayed-ali-raza: This is what Allāh’s servant ‘Alī, Amīr al-mu’minīn, has ordered Mālik ibn al-Ḥārith al-Ashtar in his instrument (of appointment) for him when he made him Governor of Egypt
for the collection of its revenues, fighting against its enemies, seeking the good of its people and making its cities prosperous.
